name: cancel_appointment
description: Call this to cancel an existing booking with Kornél — for a booking made earlier in THIS call or a previous call. Looks up their soonest upcoming booking by phone number and cancels it.

phone.description: The real caller's phone number in E.164 format — must be either the resolved caller_number value or a number the caller stated and you confirmed digit-by-digit. Never a placeholder or invented number. This is how their existing booking gets found, so it must be accurate.
